name: Floor Barbell Skullcrusher
description: Skullcrushers performed lying on the floor instead of a bench. The floor limits the range of motion at the bottom, reducing shoulder stress while still providing excellent triceps training. The floor version is accessible and forgiving for those with shoulder limitations.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Floor Barbell Skullcrusher in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Floor Barbell Skullcrusher.
steps: Step 1: Lie on floor with barbell held at arm's length above chest.
Step 2: Bend elbows to lower bar toward forehead, keeping upper arms vertical.
Step 3: Lower until triceps contact or nearly contact floor.
Step 4: Extend elbows back to starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
